messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from the Rate Limiter postmortem. Need owners + timeline for customer comms: status page wording, 72h public summary, and policy for sharing full RCAs (redaction + consent). Also call out any recurring incident signals for customers. Who takes which?

ben: I9ll take the status page text. Will draft a concise blurb + single-line TL;DR and note SLO impact. Dropping draft by tomorrow EOD. @liz please do a tone/legal pass.

liz: Happy to. Quick guidance: avoid words like "outage" if service remained available; use "brief throttling" or "partial degradation." Legal: no customer names or IDs in public text.

sam: I will own the RCA-sharing follow-up. Plan: define public vs. detailed recipients, propose redaction rules for internal identifiers, and sketch a customer consent flow for full RCAs. Target: Wed COB.

jordan: I9ll add a short recurring-pattern paragraph for the 72h summary and attach the internal pattern analysis. Found 2 similar routing-change incidents in the last 90 days; recommend an audit of routing policy changes. ETA: tomorrow morning.

maria: I added initial deliverables to the action tracker: - Status page copy  owner: ben  due: 2026-03-27 EOD; - 72h public summary  owners: liz/jordan  due: 2026-03-25 23:59 UTC; - RCA sharing policy + consent flow  owner: sam  due: 2026-03-25 COB; - Remediation plan update  owner: eng-sre  due: 2026-04-02.

ben: Draft status page: "We experienced a brief period of request throttling (429 responses) due to a misrouted quota rule. Impact: ~3% of requests for a short window. Mitigation: rerouted traffic and hotfix deployed. Next steps: permanent routing fix and observability enhancements. Updates: incidents@redwood.com." Thoughts?

liz: Edits: remove precise internal durations from public copy, add link to live status page, include a short "what we're doing to prevent recurrence" bullet list, and ensure POC email is visible.

sam: Legal requests a simple consent checkbox for customers who request the full RCA; default public summary will be redacted. I'll draft the consent language and a minimal request form.

sre-bot: Postmortem filed: https://intra/redwood/postmortems/rl-2026-03-22-1. Action tracker updated.

maria: For the 72h summary make sure to include an impact matrix (who, what, duration), mitigation steps, and the recurring-pattern note plus a single POC. I'll set calendar reminders and nudge owners 24h before due dates.
